\paragraph{Failures and recovery.}
The initial launch encountered a missing SymPy dependency before any scientific check ran. Installing the declared SymPy version made the exact examples executable. A separate preparatory file edit initially used an incorrect relative path and made no change. Both configuration events are retained in the editorial launch record. The first full run also rejected the eight-child norm check because it compared unsimplified symbolic expressions structurally. Each independently computed expression simplifies to $6$; the check now performs that simplification before comparison. A strengthened $SU(2)$ membership check subsequently exposed the same structural-comparison issue for a diagonal rational matrix; simplifying its product gives the identity exactly. The mathematical targets were unchanged. Failed manifests and logs are retained, including a repeated launch before that correction. A later integrity check found two damaged figure files of unknown cause. Atomic file writes and a fresh run restored all recorded output hashes.
